All processing happens on your device

Categorization, OTP extraction and transaction parsing run entirely on this phone. Clear SMS has no servers and makes no network calls at runtime. Your messages are never uploaded, shared or analyzed anywhere else.
No analytics, no tracking, no ads
The app contains no analytics SDKs, crash reporters that transmit data, advertising frameworks or proprietary services.
Backups are plain local files saved where you choose. They are never sent anywhere automatically.

Every categorization rule is human-readable JSON you can inspect, edit, export and contribute back to the community. Sharing rules with the developer is always an explicit action that uses your email app.
